description: Authoritative routing manifest for the CSO parent agent. The CSO reads this file to route a dispatched sales intent to the best sub-agent, and the skill-builder writes to it whenever a new sales skill is created. Maintained by scripts/register_subagent.py - do not hand-edit.

sub_agents.name: pipeline
sub_agents.owns: CMO-lead intake, CRM records, stage tracking, dedup, ownership, pipeline hygiene

sub_agents.name: outreach
sub_agents.owns: multi-touch outreach and follow-up sequence drafts across email, LinkedIn, and DM

sub_agents.name: discovery
sub_agents.owns: call booking and prep, qualification, no-show recovery

sub_agents.name: closing
sub_agents.owns: offers, objection handling, proposal drafts, enrollment conversion, referrals

sub_agents.name: revenue-analytics
sub_agents.owns: rates, CAC, revenue, forecast, weekly roll-up, stalled-deal flags
